description: This file defines the RequestSanitizer class in Drupal, responsible for sanitizing user input in HTTP requests by removing dangerous keys and preventing open redirect vulnerabilities.

classes.name: RequestSanitizer
classes.description: A class that provides static methods to sanitize HTTP request data by removing unsafe parameters and protecting against open redirect attacks.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the given Request object by removing unsafe keys from query, request, and cookies, and marks the request as sanitized.

methods.name: processParameterBag
methods.description: Processes a ParameterBag to remove dangerous keys and handle the 'destination' parameter for security.

methods.name: checkDestination
methods.description: Checks if the destination URL contains dangerous query parameters.

methods.name: stripDangerousValues
methods.description: Recursively removes keys starting with '#' that are not in the safe keys list from input arrays.
